Rstudio - 0.99.442
Spark - 1.4

In addition: Warning message:
running command '"spark-submit.cmd"  sparkr-shell C:\Users\Devansh\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpkvqWsp\backend_port27a030a92f66' had status 127 

appreciate any inputs :)
